562:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

562:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Are you sure a burial in space is really all right?」

562:t_1:6.en:
$n
「She said she loves both $$翠の地球$$ and $$蒼の地球$$. So a place where you can see both is best...」

562:t_1:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're about to launch the capsule.」

562:t_1:11.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「She always looked so happy... She cheered all of us up...」

562:t_1:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll definitely protect the two Earths you loved...」

562:t_1:16.en:
$n
「($$ティティ$$... The day I heard that story from you, I never imagined things would turn out like this...)」

562:t_1:17.en:
$n
「(We're fighting because we don't want anyone else to taste this kind of sorrow...)」

562:t_1:18.en:
$n
「(And through it all, you saved me. Thank you, $$ティティ$$...)」

562:t_1:21.en:
$n
「I'm fine, $$宗介$$. You stay with $$千鳥$$.」

562:t_1:22.en:
$n
「She had to go up to space so suddenly, so even someone like her must be feeling anxious.」

562:t_1:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry. I'll take you up on that.」

562:t_1:25.en:
$n
「I know what you want to say. ...I'll get my head straight before the operation starts.」

562:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then that's fine. But when it's too much to handle alone, rely on us.」

562:t_1:30.en:
$n
「(Redo the world... If we let those words take hold of us, we'll never be able to move forward...)」

562:t_1:31.en:
$n
「($$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... We stopped his ambition, but his words left invisible scars on our hearts...)」

562:t_1:35.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Interior: Living Quarters ～

562:t_1:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「(...$$ティティ$$. $$ノノ$$ and the others will absolutely protect the Earth you loved. Because...)」

562:t_1:37.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...It looks like the wrecked living quarters have been repaired for the time being.」

562:t_1:38.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's thanks to $$カシオ$$ and the others working hard all night.」

562:t_1:39.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Nice... Things get fixed so easily.」

562:t_1:40.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Lives that are lost never come back... You're sad about $$ティティ$$ too, aren't you, $$ニコラ$$...」

562:t_1:43.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Honestly, what I feel is... envy, I guess.」

562:t_1:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「After all, she was spared from seeing the despair that comes after this.」

562:t_1:45.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's all right, $$ニコラ$$! We'll definitely stop that future of despair! Because...!」

562:t_1:46.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ノノ$$... You don't understand at all.」

562:t_1:48.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I knew it... You don't understand me at all.」

562:t_1:49.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「How I feel, about to reach 《$$あがり$$》 and lose my $$トップレス$$ power!」

562:t_1:50.en:
$$ノノ$$
「S-stop it, $$ニコラ$$! Let go of me!」

562:t_1:53.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Of course you don't understand! How terrifying it is to lose your $$トップレス$$ power! How it feels to be a person who can't fly anymore!」

562:t_1:54.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's why! Whatever means I have to use... even if I sell my soul to the devil, I want to stop that from happening!」

562:t_1:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Did you want to go over to that $$レナード$$ person!?」

562:t_1:56.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I have my last shred of pride too! I'd rather die than bow my head to a guy like that!」

562:t_1:57.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So, $$ノノ$$! I'll take your power!」

562:t_1:59.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I want it, all of you...! You're a $$バスターマシン$$ itself, aren't you! That means you're an eternal $$トップレス$$!」

562:t_1:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So! Give me all of you!」

562:t_1:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Get away from $$ノノ$$, $$ニコラ$$!」

562:t_1:65.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Princess... and $$シンジ$$ is here too...」

562:t_1:66.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The briefing... is about to start... so I came... to get $$ノノ$$...」

562:t_1:68.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Fine. If more people get called over, it'll only turn into more trouble.」

562:t_1:69.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Why would you do something like this...」

562:t_1:70.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You and $$タケル$$ wouldn't understand!」

562:t_1:71.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Guys like $$タケル$$, who have eternally strong power, and guys like $$シンジ$$, who had an EVA handed to them by a parent, will never understand!」

562:t_1:72.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'm scared! Scared of losing my power! It's the same as dying!」

562:t_1:75.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You two got in my way! If it was going to come to this, I should have thrown away my pride and gone to $$レナード$$!」

562:t_1:76.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Then I'd have gotten the world I wanted!」

562:t_1:77.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Is that all you have to say?」

562:t_1:79.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Whatever your reasons, I can't forgive you for hurting $$ノノ$$... and $$ラルク$$ and $$シンジ$$.」

562:t_1:83.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why won't you... rely on me...?」

562:t_1:85.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You were always so confident, and cunning, and even though I knew your kindness was a lie, I still loved you...!」
